messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: SURPASS-CVOT randomized 13,299 adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease.
The adults were randomized to Mounjaro (tirzepatide, up to 15 mg once weekly) or dulaglutide 1.5 mg once weekly.
Dulaglutide is a GLP-1 medicine already approved to reduce cardiovascular risk.
The study had a median follow-up of about 4 years.
Cardiovascular death, non-fatal heart attack, or non-fatal stroke occurred in 12.1% of those taking Mounjaro.
These events occurred in 13.0% of those taking dulaglutide.
The hazard ratio was 0.92 with a 95% CI of 0.83–1.01.
The results met the trial's goal of non-inferiority.
The results did not demonstrate superiority.
Death from any cause occurred in 8.5% of the Mounjaro group.
Death from any cause occurred in 10.1% of the dulaglutide group.
The hazard ratio was 0.84 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.75–0.94.
This outcome was not a primary endpoint.
This outcome was not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
Therefore, the result should be read as exploratory.
These results describe how Mounjaro performs against another GLP-1.
Triplet: ["all-cause death", "was not adjusted for", "multiple comparisons"]

The relation 'was not adjusted for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject outcome or result was not corrected or accounted for the factor specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'underestimated due to': The subject phenomenon is underreported or underrecognized due to the factor specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be less effective in': The subject drug may not work as well in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
E. 'unknown beyond': The subject risk or effect is not known to persist or be relevant beyond the time period specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
